opennyai_summary.30_November_2021__facts: It appears that the applicant was found in possession of ra  material and other material used in manufacturing country liquor.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
However, having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, prima facie it appears that the applicability of Section 328 of the IPC appears to be doubtful.
The applicant therefore has made out a case for ad-interim protection.
opennyai_summary.30_November_2021__decision:
Hence, the following order is passed as an ad-interim measure:
 ORDER (i)
In the event of arrest of the applicant Rajaram Madhukar Khade in C.R. No. 351 of 2021 registered with Walchand Nagar Police Station, Pune for the offences punishable under Section 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e), r/w 3(i)(zz) (I), (iii),
(iv) and 5 and Sec. 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR and SB in the sum of Rs.20,000/- with one or two sureties in like amount.
(ii)The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iii) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 7th January, 2022.
(iv) This order shall remain in force till the next date.

of Police Station Walchandnagar, Pune under Section 272, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of Ipc and
Section 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e) read with Section 3(1)(zz)(i), (iii), (iv) and 5 and Section 59 of the Food
Safety and Standards Act, 2006, is seeking anticipatory bail.

4. The learned counsel for the Applicant points out that after the receipt of the report of the Analyst a Statutory Appeal has been filed before the Co-Commissioner of Food and Drugs Administration,
